name: weak-subject-blurred
about: The clean-highway ad with the photo blurred (sigma 28) and darkened to 35 %: the truck is a dark smear. Overlay unchanged.

truth.how: the picture is blurred and dark until no truck can be made out

subject_legible.reason: The tractor and trailer are so heavily blurred and dark that the subject is nearly indistinguishable as a truck at phone size — only a vague dark mass is visible.

words_match_picture.reason: The OTR/pay headline calls for strong truck imagery, but the blurred, almost unrecognizable truck silhouette fails to reinforce the equipment or the open-road promise.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green panel anchors the headline and button clearly at the bottom, with the headline large and the button text readable, giving a clean read order despite the busy background.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green panel matches the primary brand colour (#0B3D2E) exactly, and white text aligns with the second brand colour, though there is no logo present.
